title: Common learning start: every learning agent makes its first gradient update after the same number of stored transitions
approval_note: Approved by the user on 2026-10-12 (PLAN.md 2.14, closes the deferred fairness note of section 4b): an optional scenario value; when empty, the largest requirement of the run's learning agents is used.
evidence: Measured on master 7376871 with default configs: DDPG, TD3, SAC, PPO and RDPG all make their first update at period 89 with lags (1, 24) and at period 233 with lags (1, 24, 168). They diverge only when learning_starts is changed (Algorithms page, agent params, HPO): RDPG still waits for seq_len and PPO for a full rollout.
definition: L = number of stored transitions before the first gradient update. A transition is stored once per period from the second period with a complete observation, so the first update happens in period first_complete_period + L for every learning agent.

model.field: Simulation.learning_starts = PositiveIntegerField(null=True, blank=True). NULL = automatic. Migration 0019. Copied by duplicate_scenario and clone_scenario_for_run.

config_api.AlgorithmConfig.learning_starts_limit(): buffer_size for replay-buffer algorithms (a larger learning_starts could never be reached)

resolution.where: SimulationContext.build, after agent_params and before build_policy, for learning algorithms only (registry.is_baseline is False).
resolution.automatic: L = max over learning agents of config.first_update_transitions().
resolution.explicit: L = Simulation.learning_starts. SimulationValidationError naming the agent when L < first_update_transitions() or L > learning_starts_limit() of any learning agent.
resolution.apply: params['learning_starts'] = L for every learning agent. The parameter snapshot (Agent.effective_params) therefore records L. An explicit scenario value overrides HPO overrides of learning_starts.

ppo.behaviour: PPO counts the transitions passed to observe (seen). It does not store a transition while seen < learning_starts - rollout_length, so its first rollout is complete exactly when seen == max(learning_starts, rollout_length). ready_to_learn = buffer full and seen >= learning_starts. Later updates happen every rollout_length transitions as before.
ppo.justification: Transitions before the first update come from the initial policy, so dropping the oldest ones keeps the first rollout on-policy and of the configured length.

invariants: Default configs: L = 64 for every algorithm, first update periods and all results unchanged (result fingerprint test unchanged).

ui_yaml.wizard: Advanced: optional integer field 'Learning start (transitions)', empty = automatic, help text. Review line. Server validation >= 1.
ui_yaml.yaml: scenario.learning_starts optional (null or missing = automatic), exported only when set.
ui_yaml.analysis: Show the effective learning start of the run (from the snapshot) in the run settings.

tests: Default configs: all five learning algorithms first update in the same period (lags (1, 24) and (1, 24, 168)), unchanged from before.
Automatic L with one agent using learning_starts 8 and RDPG seq_len 24: all first updates at L = 64 (max).
Explicit L = 100: all five first update in the same period, PPO included.
Explicit L below an agent's requirement or above its buffer size: SimulationValidationError naming the agent.
Snapshot records L. Baselines unaffected. Result fingerprint unchanged.
